id.description: Stable slug, dedupe key, immutable once listed.

description.description: One sentence. The card has no room for two.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL (or a /site path), or "#" for a status:coming-soon placeholder with nothing live yet. The build rejects other schemes for live/archived entries.

repo.description: "owner/repo", or null when there is no source repo (e.g. Ruin).

favicon.description: "auto" lets the client-side favicon-swap try to replace the emoji; "never" opts out (data-keep-emoji).

src.description: Optional vendored, same-origin card image, e.g. "/icons/wodin.svg". Must start with /icons/, have no "..", query or hash, and name a file in the repo's icons/ directory (checked at build time). External URLs are rejected. When set, the card shows this image instead of the emoji and is never favicon-swapped; emoji stays as the documented fallback.

visibility.description: "authenticated" with status live/archived makes the tile private: never in the public index.html, only in the oaks build's private/tiles.json behind the sign-in hub. coming-soon entries render publicly as placeholders whatever the visibility. Explore gates the tile, not the linked app.
